cases.description: The Secretary uploads the audio of the ended meeting and the system transcribes it with speakers and times.
procedure: As Member B open tab "Bản ghi" of the meeting WF-03 ended, click "Tải tệp lên", choose the meeting audio, tick the consent confirmation and click "Tải lên".
Wait for the status to go from "Đang chuyển chữ" to done; open the transcript.
expected: Toast "Đã lưu bản ghi."; the recording is listed with its size and "Đang chuyển chữ".
When done, the transcript lists each sentence with its time and a speaker label.
preconditions: SYS_WF03_TC07 passed; an audio file of the meeting; the speech worker is running.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-44c, UC-45 · MSG290 · 5.2: REC_FT32, TRANS_FT01 · Round 1 not run: the speech worker does not run on the test machine. · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Secretary corrects a sentence and names a speaker in the transcript.
procedure: As Member B open the transcript of TC01, edit the text of one sentence and save.
On a speaker card assign Member A to that voice.
expected: "Đã lưu đoạn gỡ băng."; the sentence shows the edit mark with Member B's name.
"Đã gán người nói."; every sentence of that voice shows Member A.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-46a, UC-46b · MSG302, MSG316 · Round 1 not run: needs a transcript, which needs the speech worker. · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Secretary asks for the AI summary of the transcript and reviews it.
procedure: As Member B in tab "Biên bản" click "Tạo dự thảo" on the card "Dự thảo nội dung" and wait.
expected: The card shows the request queued, then the summary of sections I–III to review and approve.
preconditions: TC02 passed; the local language model is running.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-47, UC-48 · Round 1 not run: no transcript and no local language model on the test machine. · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Secretary approves the AI draft and builds the minutes from it.
procedure: As Member B edit and approve the AI draft, then click "Tạo bản nháp" on the card "Biên bản".
expected: The minutes take sections I–III from the approved draft.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-49, UC-50, UC-59 · Round 1 not run: depends on TC03. · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Secretary makes the minutes from the fixed template and submits them to the Chair; a plain member cannot see them yet.
procedure: As Member B open tab "Biên bản" (no AI draft: "Chưa có dự thảo AI nên mục I–III để trống.") and click "Tạo bản nháp".
Click "Gửi duyệt" and confirm in "Gửi biên bản cho Chủ toạ duyệt?".
As Member C open the same tab.
expected: Toast "Đã tạo bản nháp biên bản."; chip "Bản nháp"; the paper has the meeting title, Chủ toạ, Thư ký and the item conclusion of WF-03.
Toast "Đã gửi biên bản cho Chủ toạ duyệt."; chip "Chờ duyệt"; "Sửa", "Tạo lại", "Gửi duyệt" are gone; the line "Vũ Thị Lan gửi duyệt lúc …".
The Chair has a notification; Member C sees no minutes.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-59, UC-61 · MSG395, MSG424 · 5.2: MIN_FT01, MIN_FT08 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Chair returns the minutes with a reason; the Secretary reads it, corrects the minutes and submits again.
procedure: As Member A click "Trả lại", click "Trả lại" with the reason empty, then type "Bổ sung danh sách vắng mặt và ý kiến của phòng Tài chính." and click "Trả lại".
As Member B open the tab, read the reason, click "Sửa", add a line after the closing paragraph, click "Lưu", then "Gửi duyệt".
expected: An empty reason shows "Nhập lý do trả lại, tối đa 2.000 ký tự."; with a reason: toast "Đã trả lại biên bản cho Thư ký.", chip "Bị trả lại"; the Secretary is notified.
The Secretary sees "Hoàng Minh Đức trả lại: …" above the paper; "Đã lưu biên bản."; after sending: "Chờ duyệt" and the reason box is gone.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-65, UC-61 · MSG430, MSG396, MSG424 · 5.2: MIN_FT35, MIN_FT29 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: The Chair approves and issues the corrected minutes; they lock and the participants are told.
procedure: As Member A open tab "Biên bản", click "Duyệt và ban hành" and confirm in "Duyệt và ban hành biên bản?".
expected: Toast "Đã duyệt và ban hành biên bản."; chip "Đã ban hành"; only "Tải xuống" and "Tạo bản đính chính" remain; "Hoàng Minh Đức duyệt, ban hành lúc …".
Member B and Member C are notified; the system log has "minutes.issued"; editing the issued minutes is refused.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-64 · BR-408, BR-446 · MSG427 · 5.2: MIN_FT31, MIN_FT32 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8

cases.description: A member reads and downloads the issued minutes; a user outside the meeting cannot reach them.
procedure: As Member C open tab "Biên bản", click "Tải xuống" › "PDF".
As Member D (not a participant) open the same URL.
expected: Member C sees "Đã ban hành", the item conclusion and the correction, and only "Tải xuống"; the file is "Biên bản - [SYS] Họp giao ban tuần 49.pdf".
Member D sees "Không tìm thấy trang"; the minutes API answers 404.
cases.note: BF-04 · UC-58 · 5.2: MIN_FT08, MIN_FT21 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF04 20261123-065220-0c98bde8
